reviews.title: Very bad experience !! Careful
reviews.text:
I installed it and I was using the credits that it gives you by default. I purchased credits, the cheapest one on 9.99 dollars, just to use it a little bit more.

In the process the app crashed and it charged me for 5 times. I complained and they don’t want to return the money. The day that I activated the “automatic refill”, when I didn’t.

BE CAREFUL! I honestly feel stolen by this company… I will uninstall it and never use it again.
